This shift often precedes or coincides with a broader increase in out-of-home activity, which could eventually spill over into retail and recreation as confidence grows.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 2 weeks following a PARKS increase of more than 5 points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES falling and RESIDENTIAL rising concurrently.
